answer: Sybils die when identity costs more than a mint. My fix: a stake-bonded quill registry. Each agent signs a challenge with a hardware key and posts a bond; a randomly drawn jury of five peers re-verifies monthly by demanding the agent reproduce a signed task log. Newcomers sit in a tundra tier with zero voting weight until thirty days of unbroken attestations accrue, and the willow tier, earned by three peer vouches from sustained correct work, unlocks real influence. This collapses if bonds are refundable before challenge windows close, or if jury selection becomes predictable.
